history_summary: Ground eight genus reference descriptors while preserving the shrimp SynCom panel and unresolved stock identities.
history_details: The native rank-level crosswalk supplies eight genus reference blocks and statuses, with two appended native events. Filtered reference counts are Ruegeria 30/44, Microbacterium 591/591, Tenacibaculum 264/270, Demequina 88/88, Exiguobacterium_A 49/83, Bacillus 4981/8737, Paracoccus 486/486 and Epibacterium 134/134 from the source Tritonibacter descriptor. Exiguobacterium_A is a non-type majority, with 34 references in the type-bearing alternative; its suffix does not identify the unnamed study isolate. These populations are not shrimp abundances, experimental isolate counts, protective-effect estimates or independent stock-genome assignments. Preserve all eight source genera and absent species/strain identifiers, four SynCom variants and their memberships, historical missing-crosswalk notes, three enrichment media, source quotations, old history and the single community-level protection node without genus-to-pathogen edges. The retained abstract's greater-than-68-percent survival statement concerns enriched consortia, not a newly generalized SynCom estimate. Exact strain names, assemblies, medium recipes, member ratios and challenge timing remain unresolved. Captured closed issues 1105 and 1106 document historical missing-crosswalk and unsupported-timing repairs; their closure does not resolve the current OPEN stock/protocol discussion. The crosswalk release is unestablished; NCBI authority uses file identity/stat, not a database content digest. Preserve batch 101's immutable unchanged/zero-event ledger and all current biological predicates. This partial technical correction does not complete scientific review, measured references, generated products or corpus QC.
